description:
GitHub Actions workflow run 25028609129 emits the Node 20 deprecation annotation: `actions/cache@v4` and `actions/checkout@v4` currently run on Node.js 20. Node 20 is forced to Node 24 by default starting 2026-06-02 and removed from runners 2026-09-16.

Concretely the warning text:
> Node.js 20 actions are deprecated. The following actions are running on Node.js 20 and may not work as expected: actions/cache@v4, actions/checkout@v4. Actions will be forced to run with Node.js 24 by default starting June 2nd, 2026.

Fix: bump to whichever current minor of those actions ships Node 24 support (check the upstream release notes — likely a v4 patch release or a v5 line by the time you do this), or set `FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24=true` on the workflow as an interim if no compatible release exists yet. Prefer the version bump.

Gates (per CLAUDE.md):
- tests: workflow run on the merge commit must complete green and the deprecation annotation must be gone
- docs: no doc change needed
- alignment: routine CI hygiene; no spec impact
title: CI: bump actions/checkout and actions/cache off Node 20
